hypothesis: Source-span roles and native CBM node kinds can reject incidental diagnostic-name bindings while retaining useful code entities without repository-specific vocabulary.

sampling.procedure: Reproduce R000: exactly one mentioned tag, its graph flag true, nonempty parsed frames and exceptions, explicit closing relation; order by sha256(repository + '#' + issue_number). The first twelve reproduce R000. Positions 13-20 are new development cases; 21-24 remain reserved. Selection precedes new input inspection and retrieval.

pre_registered_controls: Retain the R003 identifier extraction and CBM name matching as a baseline; source roles and node kinds are separate ablations.
Keep exact verbatim log spans and native node labels; missing, ambiguous and truncated bindings remain explicit.
No repository names, known PR identifiers or evaluation reference changes may enter query construction.
Exclude all 25 registered source threads before constructing the new text corpus and its BM25 statistics; retain the earlier corpus for replay.
Compare retrieval with a primary budget of 20 distinct candidates, with 10 and 30 as secondary observations; never compare lanes with unequal total budgets as an accuracy improvement.
Keep unavailable inputs and uncertain closing-reference applicability visible instead of replacing cases after retrieval.
The previous held-out cases are known diagnostics, not an untouched validation split. The four new held-out cases remain unqueried until a policy is frozen.
acceptance: Source identities, source-span slices and native CBM node-kind decoding pass independent verification.
Known useful class and callable mentions retain evidence, while environment-path names and command arguments do not acquire unsupported runtime identities.
Fresh development cases and synthetic language-generic cases expose failure modes without tuning on reference PRs.
All research tests and repository Ruff checks pass; native evidence and deterministic replay are checked before any local commit.
A mechanism or negative result may be committed as research without promoting a default retrieval policy.

results.interpretation: The apparent known-validation hit at rank 15 disappears because its path-to-documentation binding was invalid. The new eight-case development batch yields no merged-reference hit at any registered budget for either hybrid. This is a semantic evidence correction, not a recall or generalization improvement.

Patch expands per-tensor FP8 scales for Marlin. Changed fp8.py is already in the raw stack; stack-file rank 5 and upper-symbol rank 1 are diagnostic controls, not incremental topology coverage.

First-error phrase ranks the PR 3, text fusion 67, raw-stack file history 38 and upper-symbol history 8. The 41-file PR requires specific changed-code evidence, not broad file overlap.
Unmerged MultiConnector engine_id proposal. Retained as a separate unmerged reference, not a missing mainline landing or an observed successful fix.
Patch adds bitsandbytes mappings to LlavaForConditionalGeneration. Useful entity evidence survives every filter, but entity-file rank 18 is diluted outside the hybrid top 30.

OpenVINO loader sets the current vLLM configuration and updates runner arguments. Its raw-stack history ranks the PR 18; the terminal wrapper and generic NoneType message do not identify the relevant caller.

reference_boundary: All seven merged references are native-Git descendants of their reported commits and ancestors of the frozen upper commit. Purposes and selected diffs were inspected; no GPU, server or end-to-end fix reproduction was performed.

replay.normalization: Remove only seconds and query_seconds recursively; hash sorted compact JSON. All seven pairs compare equal.

cost.note: Binding ablations reuse captured native lookups and Git histories; their latency is not end-to-end query latency. Long payload measurements are synthetic smoke tests under concurrent load, not a worst-case complexity proof. No graph archive copy or reindex was performed.

limitations: Availability-biased single-repository sample, not a generalization benchmark.
Closing references do not prove that a PR fixes the extracted error episode.
Source-role classification is a testable heuristic, not runtime type recovery.
The baseline underscore/internal-capital vocabulary omits ordinary lowercase names and many single-word class names; this ablation deliberately holds it fixed.
Source-preserved unfenced regions can include multiple episodes or intervening prose and omit diagnostics preceding the first traceback.
Only the entity-file lane is filtered here. R003 broad incident/import controls still retain their original seed construction and are not promoted.
The native projection reports and omits dangling edges. No overlapping observed endpoints were found in this batch, which does not establish global semantic graph completeness.
A documentation fix and an unmerged proposal demonstrate that runtime definitions plus mainline landings cannot cover the entire problem space.

next.hypothesis: Traceback episode structure and caller context can preserve actionable evidence hidden by terminal wrappers; evidence-aware lane composition may avoid diluting strong lexical matches.
controls: Compare raw stack paths, native CBM symbol scopes and graph expansion under the same candidate budget.
Do not claim topology gains when the same changed file is already present in the raw stack.
Retain typed source evidence, separate legitimate documentation retrieval from runtime identity, and keep unmerged coverage explicit.
Freeze a policy before querying the four reserved cases; do not tune thresholds on their reference ranks.
